Premises:N/A East 107th Street & 107 East 107th Street & 127 East 107th Street Block 1635,Lots 7,16 and 17 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTDECLARATION ，2015 (this "Declaration"), by LEXINGTON GARDENS ASSOCIATES (a/k/a Lexington Gardens Associates, L.P., the “Declarant"), a limited partnership organized under the laws of the State of New York, having an address at 405 Park Avenue, Suite 1103, New York, New York 10022 ("LexingtonGardens"). RECITALS: A． Lexington Gardens is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as 107 and 127 East 107th Street New York, New York, and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York ("Tax Map") as Block 1635, Lot 16 (hereinafter referred to as “Lot 16” and more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Exhibit A), Lot 7 (hereinafter referred to as “Lot 7"” and more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Exhibit B), and Lot 17 (hereinafter referred to as “Lot 17" and more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Exhibit C; Lexington Gardens, as owner of Lot 16 and Lot 7, hereinafter referred to as “Developer"; Lexington Gardens, as owner of Lot 17, hereinafter referred to as "Owner"; Lot 7 and Lot 16 with any buildings or improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as "Developer's Building"; Lot 17 with buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as "Owner's Building"; and Lot 17 and Owner's Building, collectively, "Owner's Parcel"). B. Lot 7, Lot 16 and Lot 17 (the “"Lots") are all contiguous along a shared property line for a distance in excess of 10 linear feet. C. Developer may desire in the future to demolish Developer's Building and construct a new building or buildings on a development site comprising all or a portion of Lot 7, Lot 16 and/or any Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined) and to construct other improvements associated with such new building or buildings (said enlargement or new building thereto not prohibited by the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as the “New Building"; Developer's Building, the New Building and any and all building and improvements now or hereafter located on Lot 7, Lot 16 and/or any Additional Parcels, hereinafter referred to collectively as “Developer's Parcel") which New Building will contain more Development Rights than would be permitted on Lot 7 and Lot 16 if considered as a single zoning lot (as hereinafter defined) under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined). D.
